common_intent_requirements.text: 一端固定的弹簧连着小滑块
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 一端固定的弹簧连着小滑块
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: a spring with one end secured to a fixed support and the other attached to a small slider on a straight horizontal guide.
A hand pulls the slider away from its resting position, extending the spring, holds it briefly, then releases it and moves clear.
The spring draws the slider back through its resting position, and the slider travels to the other side before returning.
Continue this connected back-and-forth oscillation with an overall reduction in amplitude from light resistance.

physics_checks.criterion: 滑块在弹簧恢复作用下往返，连接保持，且无再次供能时振动总体衰减。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 至少可见两个方向的运动，以及较早与较晚阶段的振动范围。
fail_examples: 弹簧完全不改变形态而滑块大幅往返
滑块与弹簧脱离后仍被远距离拉回
没有新驱动时振幅持续明显放大
not_required: 不要求精确指数衰减、胡克系数或周期
允许最后仍有小幅振动

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
